name: oss-check
description: 2 Claude Code agents that check an open source tool before you install it: what its licence allows for your usage (personal, internal, SaaS, redistribution) with the exact sentence and its file, carve-outs and dual licences included; how many packages and megabytes the install pulls in, extras included; and the network calls the code makes at first launch or keeps dormant, with the setting that cuts them. Run /oss-check:check, or just ask whether you can use a library at work.
